cohort: Participants were mothers who had live births at TU Teaching Hospital via cesarean delivery during the years 2014, 2019, and 2024.
finding: The study found an increasing trend in the overall cesarean delivery rate, rising from 39.0% in 2014 to 56.0% in 2024 among total livebirth deliveries.
mod_finding: The proportion of primary cesarean delivery increased then stabilized, while repeat cesarean delivery increased steadily, and emergency cesarean deliveries were three times more common than elective ones.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at three distinct time points: 2014, 2019, and 2024.
gest_age: Gestational age was obtained as basic data for the deliveries included in the study.
